summary: Yorkville Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K regarding an amended and restated working capital note issued to its sponsor. The Prior Note of $250,000 was increased by an additional $250,000 advance and restated into a $500,000 convertible unsecured promissory note. The note bears no interest, is due upon initial business combination or winding up, and is convertible into units at the sponsor's election at $10.00 per unit. This is a routine working capital arrangement for a SPAC seeking a business combination; no special situation is triggered.
